World-leading expert in biopolymers and fiber innovation 
Senbis is your innovation partner for sustainable polymers and fibers, from lab-scale development to pilot production and testing, all in one place with expert support.
Your R&D partner for innovation in polymers and fibers
 Explore what we can do for your industry 
Biodegradable compounds, engineered for fiber application
 Discover our biopolymer compounds 
Our activities 
We support companies to innovate and bring sustainable products to market, leveraging our expertise and state-of-the-art facilities across the entire value chain, from monomer to final product. In addition, we develop biodegradable compounds specifically designed for fiber applications.
 Senbis Polymer Innovations 
Laboratory testing & analysis 
In our fully equipped labs, we test, characterize, and optimize materials to ensure performance and quality. 
Pilot plant production 
We perform proof-of-concept and scale-up trials, spanning from the monomer stage to the prototyping of fibers and textiles 
R&D and Consulting 
Our experts support you with tailored research and technical advice, turning ideas into feasible polymer concepts. 
 Senbis Sustainable Products 
Custom made developments 
From early R&D through testing, validation, and certification, we develop compounds fit for purpose in fibrous products 
Pilot trials 
We cooperate closely with customers and production partners. Together, we refine and scale up production processes, paving the way for industrial manufacturing and continuous innovation. 
Upscaling 
We work with a select group of compounding production partners, who work under our license and quality control. We also provide support on your spinning lines. 
Our solutions per industry 
Sustainability challenges are unique to each market. That’s why Senbis delivers tailored solutions that match the specific needs of your industry. From replacing fossil-based plastics to enabling circular fashion and advancing sustainable healthcare materials, we help you move from concept to scalable reality.
 Apparel 
 BioMedical 
 Biomonomer & polymers 
 Chemical/Enzymatic recycling 
 Technical textiles 
Our sustainable compounds 
In addition to supporting partners, Senbis also develops its own products made from sustainable materials. These innovations serve as a drop-in solution for existing applications and contribute directly to our mission to eliminate the spread of microplastics from fibrous products.
 Learn more 
 GP 100 series 
 Technical multi-filament (FDY) 
 The GreenPearls 100 series is engineered for technical FDY multi-filament and mono-filament applications. This fully biobased compound group is designed industrial yarns and mono-filaments. 
Find out more → 
 GP 200 series 
 Tape extrusion 
 GreenPearls 200 series has been engineered for agriculture. This compound group is designed for tape extrusion. 
Find out more → 
 GP 300 series 
 Spun bond 
 The GreenPearls 300 series is engineered for technical non-woven applications. This fully biobased compound group is designed for high thermal resistance and superior mechanical properties to ensure durability and performance. 
Find out more → 
 GP 400 series 
 Staple filber 
 The GreenPearls 400 series is engineered for advanced textile yarn applications. This fully biobased compound group is designed for rapid degradation. 
Find out more → 
 GP 500 series 
 Mono-filament 
 The GreenPearls 500 series is engineered for artificial grass applications. This innovative compound group is designed to actively prevent microplastic pollution by ensuring that fibers generated by wear will safely biodegrade in the natural environment. 
Find out more → 
Our people make the difference 
Behind every innovation is a team of dedicated experts. With in-depth knowledge of chemistry, materials, and processes, our people work closely with you. We are bringing a personal, solution-driven approach to every project.
